notes.title: Early Release Announcement!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45102129/845fb42aaf41ab32833d0e5c3e5a96326bdae191.png
Hello everyone,

We have some exciting news to share with you. Our indie game, Light, is ready earlier than we anticipated. Instead of the previously announced release date, we’re thrilled to let you know that the game will be available sooner!

New Release Date: August 1st, 2024 (JST)

We couldn’t have achieved this without your amazing support and encouragement. Our small team has put in a lot of love and effort to bring you this game, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

Thank you for being with us on this journey. Mark your calendars and get ready to explore the world of Light a bit earlier than expected.

Happy gaming!

Warm regards,
The Light Development Team
NoteBuddy, Inc.
